AppAction.description: One of an app's tools, and what Ghost's own permissions say about it.
AppAction.title: AppAction

AppConnect.description:
Connect an app: from the catalog (``catalog`` and ``option``), from a URL, or from
another client's pasted config. Secret values go to Ghost's environment, never into
apps.json, and never come back out.
AppConnect.title: AppConnect

AppView.description: A connected app: how it is reached, whether it is up, and what it can do.
AppView.title: AppView

AppsEvent.description:
An app was connected, disconnected or changed state: read ``GET /apps``. With
``sign_in_url``, the app is waiting for the operator to sign in there; the desktop opens
it in the browser.
AppsEvent.title: AppsEvent

Build.description:
Which kind of build the running daemon is (docs/releasing.md): ``dev`` runs from a
checkout, ``deploy`` from a ``make deploy`` runtime, ``release`` from the .deb. The
commit is the full hash when known; ``dirty`` is a checkout that had uncommitted
changes when the daemon started.
Build.title: Build

CatalogEntryView.description:
An app in the catalog. Its text is the registry's: shown to the operator, never
to the model.
CatalogEntryView.title: CatalogEntryView

CatalogOption.description: One way to connect: sign in, an API key, or run on this computer.
CatalogOption.title: CatalogOption

ConversationEvent.description: The session moved to another conversation, or one was created, changed or removed.
ConversationEvent.title: ConversationEvent

ConversationUpdate.description: Each field present is applied as its own audited write.
ConversationUpdate.title: ConversationUpdate

ConversationView.description: An agent (ADR 0014, ADR 0035): a conversation with a persona and a job.
ConversationView.title: ConversationView

HookInfo.description:
A webhook in hooks.json (ADR 0027, ADR 0035): on or off, and what came of
deliveries since the daemon started. Counts only; never a body.
HookInfo.title: HookInfo

OutputInfo.description: A file Ghost made in its out/ folder (ADR 0033). Ghost never runs it.
OutputInfo.title: OutputInfo

PermissionsUpdate.description: Whole lists, the mode, or one rule moved; what is not given is kept.
PermissionsUpdate.title: PermissionsUpdate

PermissionsView.description: ``[permissions]`` in policy.toml: everything runs unless a rule says otherwise.
PermissionsView.title: PermissionsView

PhoneAddress.description: One ``GHOST_PHONE_LISTEN`` address and the network it is on.
PhoneAddress.title: PhoneAddress

PhonePairing.description: A fresh pairing code for the phone listener. Shown to the operator only.
PhonePairing.title: PhonePairing

PolicyUpdate.description:
Either the raw TOML, or the routes rendered into it (the permissions have their own
route, ``PUT /permissions``).
PolicyUpdate.title: PolicyUpdate

RoutesView.description: ``[routes]`` in the policy file (ADR 0031): how Ghost reaches the operator.
RoutesView.title: RoutesView

RuleAdd.description: A rule appended to Ghost's AGENTS.md, verbatim (ADR 0035).
RuleAdd.title: RuleAdd

RuleSet.description: One toggle: move ``rule`` into ``level``'s list, or out of every list (None).
RuleSet.title: RuleSet

RulesView.description: Ghost's AGENTS.md (ADR 0035): the rules in every agent's prompt.
RulesView.title: RulesView

conversation.description: With no session running, the line the new one opens in; Ghost when unset.
conversation.title: Conversation

path.description: A folder on this machine holding SKILL.md.
path.title: Path

SkillInfo.description: A skill Ghost can read (ADR 0023): a SKILL.md folder, Ghost's own or the operator's.
SkillInfo.title: SkillInfo

SkillListing.description:
A skill skills.sh lists (#35). Its text is the directory's: shown to the operator,
never to the model.
SkillListing.title: SkillListing

SkillOriginView.description: Where one of Ghost's skills was installed from (#35), as its lock file records it.
SkillOriginView.title: SkillOriginView

SkillPreview.description:
A skill fetched from GitHub and staged, for the operator to read before installing.
Everything in it but the hashes is the source's text: untrusted.
SkillPreview.title: SkillPreview

source.description: owner/repo, owner/repo/skill, or a github.com address of a skill's folder.
source.title: Source

SkillUpdateView.description: Whether an installed skill's source has moved on, checked when the page asks.
SkillUpdateView.title: SkillUpdateView

SourceInfo.description: A source of tools the gate knows: Ghost's own (built in) or a connected app.
SourceInfo.title: SourceInfo

VaultView.description: Ghost's vault: one encrypted file, its key in the operator's keyring.
VaultView.title: VaultView

WaitingEvent.description: The waiting list changed: read ``GET /waiting`` for it.
WaitingEvent.title: WaitingEvent

WaitingItemView.description:
One item that needs the operator. ``title`` comes from an outside system: show
it as text, never as markup. ``change`` is set for a change waiting for a yes.
WaitingItemView.title: WaitingItemView

conversation.description: The line the session opens in; Ghost when unset.
conversation.title: Conversation

text.description: Words to treat as the first turn.
text.title: Text

WatchInfo.description: A watch in watches.json (ADR 0028, ADR 0035) and how its last look went.
WatchInfo.title: WatchInfo

WatchingView.description:
What Ghost watches (ADR 0035): the watches in watches.json, the webhooks in
hooks.json, where the webhook listener is, and what is wrong in those files or left
in Ghost's folder from an older layout.
WatchingView.title: WatchingView

info.description: Local control surface for ghostd over a Unix socket. Desktop and mobile apps talk to this; the model never does. Events stream over /events.
info.title: Ghost control API

get.description: Every app in apps.json: connected or not, and what each tool may do.

post.description:
Connect an app now and keep it in apps.json. An app that signs in comes back
with the address the browser should open; the desktop opens it.

delete.description:
Disconnect: it leaves the tools at once and apps.json; its sign-in and the keys
Ghost kept for it are forgotten.

post.description: Sign in again, or reconnect an app that isn't connected.

get.description: Proposals, newest first; source narrows to one app or one of Ghost's own.

Apps to connect, from Ghost's copy of the registry; first-party ones first when
nothing is searched. An old copy is refreshed in the background.

Every agent, Ghost first, retired ones included (``retired_at`` set) so the app
can show its Retired group. ``retired=true`` or ``false`` filters.

post.description: Retire the agent: off the roster and voice routing, everything kept.

schema.title: Response Conversation Turns Conversations  Slug  Turns Get

get.description: Documents the payloads sent on the /events WebSocket. Not meant to be called.

schema.title: Response Events Schema Events Schema Get

get.description: The files Ghost made in its out/ folder (ADR 0033), by name.

post.description:
Once: heka-vault and the plaintext env files into the vault, then the plaintext
copies removed. A password already in the vault is kept.

Ask the keyring to unlock (it shows its own prompt on the desktop), then open
the vault. The daemon follows: Ghost's own settings and the apps that waited.

put.description: Save or replace one. The value is never returned, here or anywhere.

Change the mode, whole lists, or one rule; only ``[permissions]`` in the file is
rewritten, and the gate follows at once.

delete.description: Forget the paired phone; its signatures stop working at once.

post.description:
A new six-digit code for the phone, good for two minutes and five tries. It
replaces any earlier code. 409 when GHOST_PHONE_LISTEN is off.
A Confirm on a change on the waiting list (ADR 0030): the stale check runs.

get.description: Ghost's AGENTS.md: the rules in every agent's prompt (ADR 0035).

post.description:
Append a rule to Ghost's AGENTS.md, verbatim, through the gate: the operator's
own click, audited like the spoken ``rules.add`` (ADR 0035). Never written here.

get.description:
Skills on skills.sh for a search of two letters or more, from Ghost's cache when
recent. A failure is ``problem``, with the last results for the search if any.

post.description:
Copy a staged skill into Ghost's skills through the gate (``skills.install``),
audited, with where it came from.

Fetch a skill's folder from GitHub at the commit its branch is on, and stage it:
its SKILL.md and its files, for the operator to read before installing.

get.description:
For each skill Ghost installed from GitHub, whether its folder has changed at
the source since. Asks GitHub now (a recent answer per repository is reused).

schema.title: Response Skill Updates Skill Catalog Updates Get

post.description:
The newer version of an installed skill, staged like any preview; installing it
with ``replace`` and this name updates the skill.

The operator heard it: it stops alerting until it changes. Not a gate write;
it changes Ghost's own bookkeeping only.

get.description:
The watches in watches.json and the webhooks in hooks.json, each with its last
look and its counts, re-read now; where the webhook listener is; and what is wrong
in those files or left over in Ghost's folder (ADR 0035).
